title: PAPS Pathway and JUB1 Gene Regulation in Various Organisms
summary: This cluster revolves around the PAPS pathway, a method or tool, and its expression in various organisms. The pathway is expressed in Kluyveromyces lactis and Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and it integrates with these organisms. The JUB1 gene and its variant JUB1-X synTF play crucial roles in regulating the expression of various genes, including GAL1, GAL4AD, and yEGFP. JUB1-X synTF also induces the production of IPTG and produces PAPS. The PAPS pathway is also linked to the expression of PPK2, a gene_or_protein, and the production of PAPS, a chemical. The cluster highlights the complex interactions between genes, proteins, and chemicals in different organisms.
